cross_capture_comparison.method: Compare exact millisecond timestamps, Decimal rate and mark numeric values, and raw rateType including missing type; also compare normalized rate/mark/effective type. Exclude observed_at, which is capture availability. Use each symbol common inclusive query window only. No rate sums or financial outcomes are calculated.

policy_qualifications: Full 528-name coverage refers to the current captured TRADING/PERPETUAL/USDT quote-and-margin instrument universe. It does not establish historical membership, economic funding completeness, account debits or paper execution readiness.
The earlier 523-name capture remains immutable restricted-cohort evidence. The five exact Unicode identities are separate instruments and receive no transliteration, normalization or alias mapping.

No revisions found within the shared query window would establish only agreement between these two retrievals, not absence of earlier or future provider revisions. Event time and each capture first observed_at remain distinct.

Derived hour labels follow the committed inclusive [hour,hour+1 second] policy; raw daily membership is unchanged. Prior seven-day cadence inference can miss unknown faster events; current metadata is not historical schedule proof.
Latest day admissions are quoted from the preserved checker output, not recomputed in this review. SKRUSDT, TUSDT and ZKCUSDT remain unavailable; missing events are not filled or converted to zero.
